name: EAV-Fiber
title: Switch Enterprise Audio/Video Fiber
summary: L3 fiber A/V switch: 20x10G SFP+, 2x100G QSFP28, PTPv2 grandmaster/boundary with OCXO + GPS input for ST 2110.

extra.ptp_lag: PTPv2 not supported over aggregated ports

gotchas: No PoE and essentially no copper (one 1GbE) — every endpoint needs SFP+ optics/DACs.
QSFP28 breakout cables are NOT supported, so the 100G ports can't fan out to 4x25G/4x10G.
PTP doesn't run over LAG ports — design media links without aggregation.
Full-depth 1U with 4 hot-swap fans; needs a 4-post rack.
Specialist broadcast/A/V switch — for general 10G aggregation an Aggregation/Pro Aggregation switch is far cheaper.
best_for: broadcast/ProAV facilities needing ST 2110 / Dante / AES67 timing
